title: Madina Aa Gaya Zainab
body:
madina aa gaya zainab zara nigahen utha
tu apne bazu o kay 2
neel apni maa ko dekhaa...
1 batau sham se sougate dard laa ee huu
main apne cheh re pe sadyo ke gard laa ee huu.
lahu hussain ka amma haye 2
bana hai qake shifa..
2 bata rahe hai jo balo main dhul hai bibi
ke qakh par ali asghar saa phul hai bibi
tu rakh dhul kii zainab haye 2
lahead pe maa ki dekhaa..
3 lahu mai duba yeah qurta tere hussain ka hai
lahu jo rota hai beta tere hussain ka hai
haye bichane aye huu turbat haye 2
yeah teri farsh e azaa..
4 yeah ek jawan jo bhuda dekha e
dayta hai yeah he hai abide muztar tumhara potaa hai
gale kay toukh ne iskee haye .2
qamar ko thod deya..
5 na aoun hai na mohammed na qasim o asghar
hai inke baad lahed kii tarha hamma ra ghar
main ek laash huu amma haye 2
main ab kaha zindaa..
6 main thak ke baithe jaha tazeyaa nee khaye e hai
ruke jo ashk jo adha rula nee aye hai..
dekha dekha kay shahedoo..2
yeah sar rulaa ya gaya
7 sakina saat gaye thii jho saat ana sakhii
wo ghut ke margye amma rayhayee pana sakhii
main sham jaou gee bachii haye 2
seehai mera wada
